concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın genel anlam çekirdeğini verir; su ve insan topluluğu bağlamlarındaki özel sonuçlar ayrıca belirtilmelidir.

error_profile.preserves: Dalga örneğine dayanan düzensiz çalkalanma çekirdeğini eksiksiz korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin dalgayı andıran düzensiz bir devinimle çalkalanmasıdır; suda bu devinim, suyun yüzeyin üstüne kabaran dalgalar oluşturmasıyla görünür. İnsan topluluğu için kullanıldığında kalabalığın çalkalanarak birbirine girmesini anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir şey düzenli duruşunu yitirerek dalga gibi çalkalanır.
Suda çalkalanan bölüm, çevresindeki suyun üstüne yükselen dalgalar oluşturur.
İnsan topluluğunda çalkalanma, kalabalığın birbirinin içine girip karışması biçiminde gerçekleşir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Su yüzeyinin çalkalanıp çevresindeki suyun üstüne yükselen dalgalar oluşturduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Suyun hem çalkalanmasını hem de yüzeyin üstüne kabaran dalgalar oluşturmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insan kalabalığının dalga gibi devinerek üyelerinin birbirinin içine girdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluğun çalkalanmasını ve insanların birbirinin içine girmesini birlikte korur.

error_profile.loses: Genel çalkalanmayı ve insan topluluğunun birbirine girmesi yönünü siler.
error_profile.preserves: Su yüzeyinin çevresindeki suyun üstüne yükselmesi yönünü korur.

error_profile.adds: Dalga benzeri bir devinim bulunmayan her türlü düzensizliği de kapsar.
error_profile.loses: Dalga benzeri devinimi ve suyun üstüne yükselen dalga görünümünü siler.
error_profile.preserves: Düzenin bozulmasını ve insan topluluğundaki iç içe geçişi kısmen korur.

error_profile.adds: Canlılığın sona ermesi gibi bu dalla ilgisiz bir sonuç ekler.
error_profile.collision: Çalkalanmayı değil, canlılığın sona ermesini bildiren ayrı anlamla çakışır.
error_profile.loses: Çalkalanma, dalga yükselmesi ve topluluğun birbirine girmesi bütünüyle kaybolur.
error_profile.preserves: Yalnızca yanıltıcı bir ses çağrışımı kalır; anlam çekirdeği korunmaz.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek dalga benzeri çalkalanmadır; suyun kabarması özelleşme, insanların birbirine girmesi ise yapıya bağlı bir genişlemedir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın kaynak sözü, ortak çekirdeği bir şeydeki dalga benzeri çalkalanma olarak verir; suyun üstüne yükselen dalga bunun somut görünümüdür. Verilen çerçeve bu yönüyle kullanılabilir, ancak iç içe girme bütün dala ait değildir ve yalnızca insanların çalkalanmasını anlatan kullanımla sınırlandırılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak anlam dalga benzeri çalkalanmadır; su dalgasını bildiren biçim ile insanların birbirine girdiği söz öbekleri ayrı yüzler olarak tutulur ve bütün dala genellenmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sekiz adayın tümü değerlendirildi. Yayılarak dağılmayı anlatan root_000799/B004, yukarıdan dökülmeyi anlatan root_000838/B001 ve kalabalığın büyüklüğünü anlatan root_000496/B002 yalnızca uzak bir devinim ya da sahne ortaklığı taşıdığı için yayımlanan ayrımlara alınmadı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal, çalkalanmayı dalga görünümüne bağlar ve su ile kalabalıkta belirgin sonuçlar verir. Komşu dal ise devinme ve sarsılmayı daha genel tutar; dalgaya benzer biçim onun bütün kullanımlarında zorunlu değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dalga biçimli çalkalanma, suyun üstüne yükselen dalga ve kalabalığın birbirine girmesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Darbe alanın, birliğin ya da başın dalga zorunluluğu olmadan devinmesi gibi kullanımlar bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir şeyin düzenli duruşunu yitirerek çalkalanmasını anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ölçüsü dalga gibi çalkalanmadır ve su dalgası ile kalabalığın iç içe girmesini kapsar. Komşu dal gidip gelme yönünü ve yana sapma türlerini ayrıca taşır; bu yüzden kapsamları tam olarak birbirinin yerine geçmez.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Suyun üstüne yükselen dalga ile insan kalabalığının birbirine girmesi odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gidip gelme yönü, göğün devinmesi ve kolda yana eğilme gibi özel kullanımlar komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da dalgalanma ve düzensiz devinme alanında önemli ölçüde örtüşür.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal su dalgasını çalkalanmanın sonucu olarak kavrar. Komşu dalda belirleyici olan çalkantı değil, parçaların üst üste binerek yükselmesidir; bu nedenle yalnızca su dalgası görünümünde yakınlaşırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Düzensiz çalkalanma ve bunun insan topluluğunda birbirine girme biçimi odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin parçalarının üst üste binmesi ve bir bölümünün ötekinin üstüne yükselmesi komşu dalın çekirdeğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Suda yükselen dalgalar iki dalın görünür biçimlerinin kesiştiği alandır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal dalga benzeri çalkalanmayı su dışına da taşıyan genel bir çekirdeğe sahiptir. Komşu dal ise dalganın ileri geri gidişini öne çıkarır ve buna bağlı dar benzetmelerle sınırlı kalır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Herhangi bir şeydeki dalga benzeri çalkalanma ve kalabalığın birbirine girmesi odak dalda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dalgadaki ileri geri gidiş ile atın çırpınmasına yapılan benzetme komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da çalkantılı dalganın düzensiz devinimini konu edinir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği dalga gibi çalkalanmadır ve alanı suyla sınırlı değildir. Komşu dal yalnızca rüzgârın kaldırdığı belirli su katlarını adlandırır; ortak deniz görünümüne karşın anlam çekirdekleri ayrı kalır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Genel çalkalanma, olağan su dalgası ve insan kalabalığının birbirine girmesi odak dalda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Rüzgârın su yüzeyinden kaldırdığı ve dalgadan ayrı tutulan su katları komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da deniz yüzeyinde yükselen su biçimlerini anlatır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد يدل على اضطراب في الشيء (maqayis)؛ الموج ما ارتفع من الماء فوق الماء (ayn)؛ الموج معروف وماج البحر إذا اضطرب (jamhara)؛ ماج البحر يموج موجا: اضطربت أمواجه وكذلك الناس يموجون (sihah)؛ الموج في البحر: ما يعلو من غوارب الماء وماج كذا وتموج: اضطرب اضطراب الموج (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, su dalgasında açıkça görülen yükselip alçalan çalkalanmadır. Bu çekirdek başka şeylerin düzensizce çalkalanmasına uygulanır; insanlara uygulandığında topluluğun dalga gibi devinmesi ve birbirinin içine girmesi öne çıkar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه موج البحر وارتفاع الماء واضطرابه، وكل اضطراب في شيء، واضطراب الناس أو دخول بعضهم في بعض على صورة الموج.

concept_gloss.text: Bir şeyin dalgayı andıran düzensiz bir devinimle çalkalanmasıdır; suda bu devinim, suyun yüzeyin üstüne kabaran dalgalar oluşturmasıyla görünür

concept_map.definition: Bir kisinin ya da seyin zararli, baglayici veya istenmeyen bir durumdan ayrilip uzaklasarak kurtulmasi; ettirgen bicimlerde baska birini bu ayrilmaya ulastirip kurtarmadir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam, kotu veya baglayici bir seyden ayrilip uzaklasarak kurtulmadir.
Ettirgen kullanim, baskasini ayni kurtulus sonucuna ulastirmayi bildirir.
Kurtulus sebebi adi, kisiyi tehlikeden ayiran arac ya da yol olarak baglidir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin kotu bir durumdan cikmasi anlatildiginda dogal Turkce karsiliktir; ayrilma yolu baglamdan anlasilir.

error_profile.loses: Ayrilip uzaklasma islemini acikca soylemeyebilir.
error_profile.preserves: Kurtulus sonucunu dogal bicimde korur.

error_profile.preserves: Baskasini kurtulus durumuna ulastirma iliskisini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, kurtulusun ayrilma ve uzaklasma ile gerceklesmesine baglidir; yalniz hiz veya yalniz koruma degildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kisinin ya da seyin zararli veya istenmeyen bir durumdan ondan ayrilip uzaklasarak kurtulmasini ve baska birini bu durumdan kurtarmayi birlikte verir. Gecici dal cercevesi bu ayrilma yoluyla kurtulus cekirdegini dogru tasir; hiz, gizli konusma ve bedensel cikinti anlamlari bu dalin disinda kalir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karisik kapsam, yalpan kurtulma fiilini, baskasini kurtarma bicimlerini ve sebep adi kullanimini ayri ama ayni cekirdege bagli tutar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komsular kurtarma, siginak, koruma, hiz ve ayni kokun obur dallari acisindan denetlendi; yalniz siniri aciklastiran en yararli karsitliklar yayinlandi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yerine koyma ancak kurtarma olayinin kendisi anlatildiginda mumkundur. Bu dal ayrilma yoluyla kurtulma ve kurtulmus olma tarafini da tasirken, komsu dal daha belirgin olarak etkin kurtarma eylemini anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kurtulanin bir seyden ayrilip uzaklasmasini da cekirdekte tutar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal ozellikle birini zor durumdan veya baskasinin elinden cekip cikarma eylemine odaklanir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da zararli veya baglayici bir durumdan kurtulus ya da kurtarma vardir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dalda once bir yere takilma veya tutulma durumu daha belirgindir. Bu dal daha genis olarak serden, kisiden veya durumdan ayrilarak kurtulmayi karsilar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal genel olarak istenmeyen seyden ayrilip kurtulmayi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal ozellikle bir seye takilmis veya tutulmus durumdan cikmayi vurgular.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da baglayici bir halden cikis ve kurtulus bulunur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda uzaklasma kurtulusun yoludur; komsu dalda uzaklasma hiz ve acele hareket olarak tanimlanir. Bu yuzden biri digerinin yerine genel olarak kullanilmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalin sonucu kurtulustur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dalin cekirdegi hizli gitme ve one gecmedir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da bir yerden uzaklasma dusuncesi bulunabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak, bir seyin icinden veya etkisinden ayrilarak kurtulma fikrini verir; ayni ag icinde baskasini kurtarma ve kurtulusa sebep olan sey de yer alir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam hizli gitme, acele etme ve hareketle one gecmedir.
Binek nitelemesinde hizli deve ya da hizli tasit hayvani anlamina ozellesir.
Yolculuk emrinde oyalanmadan surmek ve gecikmemek anlamina baglanir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yolculukta oyalanmadan hareket etme emirleri ve fiil kullanimlari icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Acele hareket ve gitme anlamini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Binek hayvan nitelemesinde dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Hizli binek ozellesmesini korur.

error_profile.loses: Hiz ve one gecme cekirdegini yitirir.
error_profile.preserves: Uzaklasma cagrisimini kismen koruyabilir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, hareketin hizina ve one gecmeye baglidir; tehlikeden kurtulma sonucu bu dalin cekirdegi degildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insan, binek veya yolculuk icin hizli gitme, acele etme ve one gecme anlamini acikca verir. Dal cercevesi bu hareket-hiz alanini dogru temsil eder; kurtulus, gizli konusma ve bedensel temizlik anlamlari bu daldan ayridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bulut adinda birlesir, ancak bu adin bulutun ilk olusumu mu, suyunu bosaltmis hali mi, acilip dagilmasi mi yoksa uzaklasmasi mi oldugunu farkli bicimlerde aciklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalniz bu tartismali collocation icin uygundur; koklama anlamini kokun genel anlami yapmaz.

error_profile.preserves: Agiz kokusunu deneme ve tartismali kapsam sinirini korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kisinin agiz kokusunu anlamak icin onu koklama ya da sinama anlamidir; bu okuma kaynaklarda aktarilir, fakat delilinin gizli konusma anlamina da cekilebilecegi kaydedilir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam, bir kisinin agiz kokusunu koklayip sinamadir.
Anlamin delili konusunda itiraz vardir; ilgili soz gizli konusma diye de anlasilabilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kisinin nefes kokusunu dogrudan deneme baglaminda dogal Turkce karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Agiz kokusunu koklayarak sinama eylemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sadece itiraz edilen siir yorumu gizli konusma diye alindiginda gecerlidir.

error_profile.adds: Gizli konusma anlamini ekler.
error_profile.collision: B005 dalinin anlamiyla karisir.
error_profile.loses: Agiz kokusunu sinama anlamini yitirir.
error_profile.preserves: Tartismali delilin obur yorumunu korur.

error_profile.adds: Her turlu koku alma eylemini kapsayacak kadar genisler.
error_profile.preserves: Koklama eylemini korur.

error_profile.adds: Karsilikli gizli konusma anlamini ekler.
error_profile.collision: B005 dalinin ana anlami ile karisir.
error_profile.loses: Agiz kokusunu sinama cekirdegini yitirir.
error_profile.preserves: Itiraz edilen yorumla temas kurar.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir kisinin agiz kokusunu deneme anlamiyla sinirlidir; tartismali oldugu ve gizli konusma ile karisabilecegi belirtilmelidir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi birini agiz kokusu bakimindan sinama anlamini birkac kaynakta aktarir, fakat bir kaynak bunu siir deliline dayandirma konusunda itiraz edip soz konusu yerde gizli konusma anlamini tercih eder. Dal korunabilir, ancak anlam yalniz bu anlamı kabul eden nakillerle sinirli ve tartismali olarak yazilmalidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Collocation kapsam, anlami bir kisiyi koku bakimindan sinama ifadesine baglar ve genel yalın kok anlami yapmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Koku alma, nefes kokusu, agiz, ortaya cikarma, gizli konusma ve ayni kok dallari denetlendi; tartismali siniri gosteren adaylar yayinlandi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal, koku almayi belirli kisi ve agiz kokusu sinamasi baglamina daraltir. Komsu dal her tur kokuyu burunla algilamaya daha genel uygulanir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ozellikle bir kisinin agiz kokusunu sinama collocationina baglidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal genel olarak burunla koku alma ve kokuyu algilama eylemini anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da koku alma eylemi vardir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal koku niteligini ve kokunun varligini anlatir. Bu dalda belirleyici olan, bir kisiyi agiz kokusu bakimindan deneme eylemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal koku alma sinamasini anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal kokunun kendisi, iyi veya kotu koku ve kokuyu algilama alanini genis kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da nefes veya koku algisi bulunabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal koku sinamasini, komsu dal ise gizli konusmayi anlatir. Itiraz edilen delil nedeniyle sinir notu gerekir, ama dallar anlam bakimindan yerine konmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal tartismali olarak agiz kokusunu sinama anlamini korur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal gizli konusma ve sir paylasimini cekirdek yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir delilin yorumunda iki anlam birbiriyle temas eder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklarin cogu bir kisinin agiz kokusunu sinama anlamini aktarir; buna karsilik aktarilan delilin aslinda gizli konusma anlamina gelebilecegi yolunda bir itiraz da vardir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bedenin gerilip uzatilmasi hareketi icin dogrudan karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Beden germe hareketini korur.

concept_map.definition: Bedenin gerilerek uzatilmasi, yani gerinme hareketidir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam, bedenin gerilip uzatilmasi hareketidir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gerinme hareketinin aciklanmasi gerektiginde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bedenin gerilip uzatilmasi eylemini korur.

error_profile.adds: Yatmak veya bir yere dogru erismek gibi ek anlamlari katar.
error_profile.preserves: Bedeni uzatma yonunu kismen korur.

error_profile.adds: Gizli konusma ve kisi iliskisini ekler.
error_profile.collision: B005 dalinin anlamiyla karisir.
error_profile.loses: Beden germe hareketini yitirir.
error_profile.preserves: Ayni kok ailesindeki ayri bir alana isaret eder.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bedenin gerinmesiyle sinirlidir ve kokun obur anlam alanlarina genisletilmez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek ve acik bicimde gerinme anlamini verir. Dal cercevesi bu sinirli beden durusu anlamini dogru temsil eder; sir, yuksek yer, cikinti veya kurtulus alanlariyla karistirilmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bare kapsam, gerinme adini dalin yalın anlami olarak verir; belirli bir tamlamaya baglamaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Beden uzatma, boyun germe, yere serilme, oturus ve ayni kok dallari denetlendi; dar gerinme sinirini gosteren adaylar yayinlandi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bedensel gerinme olarak dar ve somuttur. Komsu dal genel uzatma alanidir ve bedene sinirli degildir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ozellikle bedenin gerinme hareketidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal nesne, beden, el veya bakis gibi pek cok seyde genel uzatma ve uzanma alanini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da uzatma veya germe hareketi bulunur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal bedenin belli parcasina, ozellikle boyna odaklanir. Bu dal daha genel gerinme hareketidir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal butun bedenin gerinmesini anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal ozellikle boynun uzunlugu, kaldirilmasi ve uzatilmasidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da bedensel uzama veya germe gorulur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal aktif gerinmeyi anlatir. Komsu dal yerde yayilma veya serilme durusudur; hareket ve beden iliskisi ayni degildir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal gerilerek uzama hareketidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal yere serilme, yayilma veya kollarin yere acilmasi gibi duruslari anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal beden durusu ve uzanma sahnesinde temas eder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak verisi bu dali gerinme hareketi olarak tekil ve dar bir anlamla verir.

root_profile.summary: Bu kok ailesi ayrilma ile kurtulma, hizli uzaklasma, yuzeyden ayirma, yuksek yer, gizli konusma, bedenden cikan sey ve temizleme, bulut adi, agiz kokusunu sinama ve gerinme gibi birbirinden ayrilmis anlam alanlarina dagilir. Dallar arasinda yer yer ayrilma veya uzaklasma sezgisi gorulse de butun profil acikca cok anlamli ve karisik orgutludur.

text.arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا غَشِيَهُم مَّوْجٌۭ كَٱلظُّلَلِ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ فَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌۭ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا كُلُّ خَتَّارٍۢ كَفُورٍۢ

baseline.text: Dağlar gibi dalgalar onları kapladığında, dini yalnız O'na özgü kılarak Allah'a yalvarırlar. Allah onları karaya çıkarıp kurtardığında içlerinden kimi orta yolu tutar. Ayetlerimizi ancak çok hain ve çok nankör olanlar inkâr eder.

findings.text: Alttaki taşıyıcı denizin üstten örten bir tehdide dönüşmesi, dış ufukları kapatırken içerideki bölünmüş bağlılıkları da katışıksız bir yönelişe indirger.
Kurtuluşun kişiyi karaya ayırması, kriz sırasında söylenen bağlılığın doğruluğunu sınayabileceği sağlam ve açık bir alan kurar.
Orta yolu tutmak, kriz yoğunluğu geçtikten sonra yönü sürdürülebilir bir ölçüde koruyan kalıntı sadakati anlatabilir; ayet bunun bağlılık azalmasını da dışlamaz.
Kurtuluşla işaret ve nimet deneyimlenmiş olduğundan sonraki inkâr kanıt yokluğu değil, bilinen bir ilişkiye sadakatsizliktir.

activation_trace.role: A cover literally rises over and hides them, supplying the enclosing pressure of the filter.
Intermingled turbulence destabilizes the prior arrangement and makes separation urgent.
An overhead canopy closes the scene vertically and intensifies exposure beneath it.
The spoken call inclines attention toward one addressee under pressure.
Purification after admixture makes emergency devotion an unmixing rather than merely an increase of feeling.
Obedience and submission name what the crisis temporarily concentrates on God alone.

changed_reading.after: The storm acts as a pressure filter: enclosure and turbulence temporarily unmix a divided allegiance into exclusive obedience.
changed_reading.before: They pray sincerely because they are afraid.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The wave covers them like overhead canopies, whereupon they call God while making the dīn exclusive to Him.
baseline_models.mechanism: Layered external covering and intermingled turbulence strip away ordinary mixtures of allegiance; calling, purification, and exclusive obedience form a pressure-filtered devotion.

activation_trace.role: Escape from a snare gives sincerity an active disentangling image.
Rescue by separation externalizes the prior inward disengagement.
Raised ground that flood cannot overtop supplies the topography of achieved extraction.
Dry land opposite sea is the concrete endpoint of the outward rescue.

changed_reading.after: Sincerity and rescue repeat one mechanism at two levels: inward unentangling is followed by bodily separation onto flood-safe land.
changed_reading.before: Sincerity is an attitude followed by an unrelated physical rescue.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Mukhlisīn precedes divine rescue to the barr.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root of sincerity also images escape from entanglement; that inward extraction anticipates rescue by separation and arrival on flood-safe, dry ground. The body is extracted after allegiance has already enacted extraction.

activation_trace.role: The sea-to-dry-land transition gives qasd a literal terrain on which a course can continue.
Directed movement toward a goal makes muqtasid a survivor who retains orientation.
Straightness of path and gait turns retained orientation into continued conduct.

changed_reading.after: One live reading is navigational: some survivors continue on a directed, straight course after landfall.
changed_reading.before: Muqtasid means only moderately observant or middling.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: After the terrain changes from sea to barr, some are muqtasid.
baseline_models.mechanism: Qasd can be directed movement and a straight course. In a travel-rescue sequence, the survivor may be the one who keeps the newly recovered bearing on land.

activation_trace.role: A middle position between extremes supports measured, incomplete persistence after rescue.
Total inclusion intensifies the opposed vice formula and leaves the earlier subgroup deliberately non-total.
Failure of fidelity marks the adverse pole without forcing every partial survivor into it.

changed_reading.after: A coexisting reading preserves measured partial fidelity: crisis-total devotion settles into a bounded middle that is not identical with treacherous denial.
changed_reading.before: Muqtasid must be either wholly praiseworthy or a euphemism for denial.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The partition f مِنهم leaves a measured subgroup before the totalizing كل ختار كفور.
baseline_models.mechanism: The moderation branch of qasd supports partial, bounded fidelity rather than full crisis intensity; the contrast between a subgroup and the all-encompassing vice formula keeps this reading distinct from directional constancy.

activation_trace.role: A visible mark makes the rescue available as evidence rather than private sentiment.
Denial against inward knowledge makes the reversal deliberate rather than uninformed.
Treachery and failure to fulfill convert crisis allegiance into a broken fidelity.
Covering returns as the human action that hides what the removed wave exposed.
Covering a favor makes rescue itself the blessing suppressed by post-crisis conduct.

changed_reading.after: The ending diagnoses a post-rescue counteraction: known evidence and received favor are deliberately re-covered, betraying the allegiance voiced under threat.
changed_reading.before: The ending generically condemns unbelievers and the ungrateful.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: After rescue, the ayah moves from signs to knowing denial, betrayal, and intensive ingratitude.
baseline_models.mechanism: A manifest sign has just been experienced. Juhūd denies what is inwardly known, khatr breaks the crisis fidelity, and kufr re-covers both truth and favor. Once the wave's cover is removed, the denier becomes the covering agent.

activation_trace.role: The focus word supplies the straight-course anchor that the context route network activates.
Gentle direction toward the right path supplies the positive bearing.
Straying explicitly away from guidance and qasd supplies the negative counterpart.
An extended traversable path turns the contrast into a route mechanism.
Straight, even walking makes qasd an enacted gait before it names the rescued subgroup.
Literal movement supplies the bodily carrier of the straight course.

changed_reading.after: Muqtasid can be the survivor whose crisis-recovered orientation becomes a straight, embodied gait on land; measured moderation remains a separate reading.
changed_reading.before: Muqtasid is a static label for a moderate person.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered context builds a route lexicon: gentle guidance, loss of guidance and qasd, an extended path, and finally the command to enact qasd in walking. This turns the focus participle into embodied retention of bearing while leaving moderation live.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guidance, straying from qasd, path, and qasd-in-walking; I infer that the later participle retains this travel mechanism after landfall; the materially live alternative is economic or ethical moderation without a route image.
structural_cues: The sequence 31:3, 31:6, and 31:19 moves from guidance to path-loss to regulated gait before the sea scene.
The sea-to-land transition in 31:32 makes continued bearing pragmatically salient.

activation_trace.role: Literal storm-covering supplies the physical state later imitated by self-covering.
Knowing denial identifies the insulation as willed rather than mere lack of access.
Covering supplies the human reenactment of the enclosure that the rescue removed.
The recited sign is an outwardly available marker against which closure occurs.
Turning away gives denial a bodily direction.
Hearing as understanding and compliance shows what the feigned deafness blocks.
Ear-heaviness supplies the image of deliberately thickened access to a sign.

changed_reading.after: Denial is enacted self-insulation: the rescued person rebuilds, through turning and blocked uptake, the cover from which the body was freed.
changed_reading.before: Post-rescue denial is a bare change of opinion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sign encounter depicts turning away and treating the ear as heavy despite recitation. Joined to the focus sequence of covering, visible sign, and knowing denial, kufr becomes manufactured perceptual insulation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily turning, blocked understanding, storm-covering, and knowing denial; I infer a repeated enclosure mechanism moving from environment to perception; the alternative is that 31:7 is only a separate portrait of arrogance.
structural_cues: Both 31:7 and 31:32 use an إذا encounter with signs followed by a response.
The focus reverses physical covering into moral covering only after the sign-bearing rescue.

activation_trace.role: Outward emergence and disclosure supply the surface pole of the reversal.
Hidden inward reality supplies the interior pole where sincerity and later suppression operate.
External covering begins the focus sequence by hiding and enclosing bodies.
Inner purification answers the external enclosure with clarified allegiance.
The rescue becomes an outwardly legible mark.
Renewed covering closes the sequence inside the perceiver.

changed_reading.after: An exploratory chiasm emerges: outward concealment reveals the inward state, outward deliverance becomes a sign, and the inward state then conceals that sign.
changed_reading.before: The ayah moves linearly from danger to prayer to rescue to denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context's outward/inward blessing pair activates a four-step reversal in the focus: outward cover, inward purification, outward rescue-sign, inward re-covering. Surface and interior exchange which one reveals and which one hides.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the outward/inward pair and the focus alternation; I infer a chiastic transfer of covering between world and perceiver; the alternative is a simple chronological sequence with no designed surface-interior symmetry.
structural_cues: 31:20 explicitly coordinates outward and inward blessings.
31:32 alternates an external state, an internal posture, an external event, and an internal counter-posture.

activation_trace.role: The focus call inclines speech and attention toward God under threat.
Exclusive separation from partnership makes the call a singular allegiance.
A rival caller inclines the same people toward a destructive destination.
The rebellious caller personifies the competing summons.
Calling upon what is besides God supplies the rival address that crisis excludes.
Loss of truth and stability marks the rival call's footing as unable to hold.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the true pole toward which the storm-call turns.

changed_reading.after: The plea is a temporary realignment of caller, addressee, and destination within a wider contest of summons; landfall tests whether that alignment persists.
changed_reading.before: The sea prayer is an isolated spontaneous plea.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the context, calling is a directional force: the adversary calls people, false objects are called upon, and under the wave people call God exclusively. Crisis temporarily collapses a field of competing summons into one true orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three call configurations and the true/false contrast; I infer that crisis reorients agency within a competing-call field; the alternative is that the repeated root is thematic but not mechanistically linked to relapse.
structural_cues: The subject-object reversal is sharp: in 31:21 they are called, in 31:30 other objects are called, and in 31:32 they call God.
Exclusive dīn grammatically narrows the addressee at the crisis peak.

activation_trace.role: The literal ship places the sign-recognition pair aboard the same maritime scene as the focus.
Divine favor supplies what rescue later requires the survivor to recognize.
Manifest markers frame the voyage and its reversal as evidence to be read.
Holding the self from panic supplies the virtue appropriate to the wave phase.
A hardship with no apparent exit sharpens steadfastness into the exact enclosure tested by the wave.
Recognition of favor supplies the virtue appropriate to landfall.
Turbulent wave movement instantiates the first, steadfastness-testing phase.
Covering the favor names the inverse outcome of the gratitude phase.

changed_reading.after: The ayah is a two-phase sign assay: steadfastness belongs under enclosure, while gratitude becomes decisive after rescue, where betrayal can re-cover the favor.
changed_reading.before: The ayah is simply an example of inconsistent emergency piety.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ship verse names divine favor and signs for every steadfast, grateful person. The focus then stages the assay in time: enclosure tests self-restraint, rescue tests recognition of favor, and khattār-kafūr names failure after the second phase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacent maritime sign frame and the steadfast-grateful pair; I infer that 31:32 narratively tests the pair in successive phases; the alternative is that the pair only describes observers and does not structure the episode.
structural_cues: 31:31 and 31:32 are adjacent and share ship, sea, signs, and the كل character formula.
The focus's temporal clauses divide the episode into danger and after-rescue response.

activation_trace.role: Raised flood-safe ground supplies genuine local rescue without implying finality.
Dry land marks a relative destination opposed to sea.
Return to a prior destination reopens movement beyond apparent landfall.
Extended enjoyment supplies the provisional interval after immediate danger.
Smallness contracts that interval and prevents it from reading as final safety.
Compulsion removes the survivor's control over the next transition.
A fixed temporal limit places all movement, including rescued movement, under an endpoint.

changed_reading.after: Landfall is real but provisional safety: it opens the interval in which remembered orientation, gratitude, or betrayal becomes visible.
changed_reading.before: Reaching land is the completed happy endpoint of the episode.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nearby return, brief enjoyment, compulsion, and appointed term reopen the future after rescue. Barr is safe relative to the wave but remains inside a timed moral itinerary, so rescue is reprieve and testing ground rather than terminal arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies local rescue, return, short enjoyment, compulsion, and term; I infer that landfall is a probationary interval; the alternative is that the later timing language concerns only final judgment and should not color the rescue scene.
structural_cues: The ethical division occurs after rescue, showing that land begins rather than ends the decisive response.
31:23-24 and 31:29 repeatedly place present continuance inside return and term.

activation_trace.role: Dry land supplies the returned ordinary environment whose safety can be overread.
Broken fidelity names the behavioral result of trusting the returned calm.
Covering the rescue-favor is the cognitive effect attributed to deceptive ease.
A gleam that does not hold supplies the mechanism by which apparent safety displaces crisis clarity.
Unknown risk in the outcome makes confidence in the calm shore structurally hazardous.
The near present life locates the deceptive horizon in returned ordinary existence.

changed_reading.after: Sea is bodily danger that exposes allegiance, while shore may become ethical danger by making the exposed truth seem unnecessary once calm returns.
changed_reading.before: Sea is danger and shore is unqualified safety.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate warning against worldly deception activates a reversal: the wave is overtly dangerous but disclosure-producing, whereas restored terrestrial ease can gleam without stability and induce re-covering. Shore can therefore be ethically more dangerous than sea.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies post-land betrayal and an immediate warning about unstable worldly deception; I infer that returned ease is one vehicle of that deception; the alternative is a general warning unrelated to the shore transition.
structural_cues: The deception warning immediately follows the focus ayah.
The focus places betrayal only after the transition to land.

remaining_uncertainties: The balance between directional straightness and measured partial fidelity in muqtasid remains intentionally unresolved.
The visible-hidden chiasm and deceptive-shore reading are sequence-based inferences rather than necessary lexical entailments.
The l-j-j and gh-w-th outliers depend on non-dominant mapped inventories and must remain qualified activations, not glosses.
strongest_changes: Muqtasid shifts from a single middling label into coexisting directional and measured readings, with a contained severed-remainder echo.
The adjacent ship-sign verse turns the focus into a two-phase assay: steadfastness under enclosure and gratitude after rescue.
Rescue is doubled as inward unentangling and outward extraction, while denial deliberately rebuilds covering after the wave-cover is removed.
Landfall becomes a provisional and potentially deceptive testing interval rather than an unqualified endpoint.
summary.what_was_special: The focus repeatedly reverses one image: covering first belongs to the wave, purification uncovers allegiance, rescue exposes a sign, and the khattār-kafūr then becomes the agent who covers known favor. Ordered route cues, the preceding ṣabbār-shakūr pair, and non-dominant mapped roots preserve several mechanistic readings without collapsing them.

activation_trace.role: Breaking and separation activate a branch-distant image of a remainder cut out from the former mass.
Rescue by separation gives the broken-off image a real event-level anchor.
Total inclusion in the vice formula supplies the whole against which the rescued subgroup appears as a remainder.

changed_reading.after: As a contained branch echo, muqtasid can also image a survivor severed from the engulfing totality and left as a morally undecided remainder.
changed_reading.before: Muqtasid only classifies a survivor's degree or direction of fidelity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the breaking branch is form-distant from the participial use of muqtasid; it remains anchored in the exact focus root, the rescue-by-separation sequence, and the subgroup syntax. Downstream prose should present it only as an imagistic echo of a severed remainder, never as a lexical replacement for moderation or straightness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: From among the rescued group, a muqtasid remains after separation from the engulfing whole.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped target contributes the depth and enclosure of the sea to the repeated insertion movement.
Interwoven darkness turns night insertion into a covering motion parallel to the storm canopy.
Literal turbulent wave motion anchors the overlay in the focus scene.
Night-darkness within the shade root links canopy enclosure to the neighboring night/day cycle.
Raised ground beyond flood supplies the emergence pole opposite dark maritime ingress.

changed_reading.after: In a contained split-root overlay, storm and rescue become ingress and emergence across a dark maritime threshold, resonating with the neighboring insertion of night and day.
changed_reading.before: The storm is a self-contained natural danger between two stable states.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant l-j-j target attached to the context root w-l-j. It remains valid as activation because that target explicitly supplies sea-depth and darkness while the focus supplies literal wave, canopy, and raised rescue ground. Downstream prose must call it a split-root cross-domain overlay, not claim that w-l-j or the focus words lexically mean sea-depth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The wave-canopy encloses people before rescue lifts them onto flood-safe ground.

activation_trace.role: Relief of one in distress makes descending water an aid-side counterpart to the threatening wave.
The non-dominant distress-aid target activates succor at the exact pressure point staged in the focus.
A cry for help mirrors the focus's spoken call from within danger.
The turbulent wave fixes water's threatening pole in the focus.
The directed call supplies the human pivot between threat and hoped-for aid.
Rescue by separation supplies the realized relief pole.

changed_reading.after: As an exploratory water-cycle analogy, the same domain can bear engulfment or descending relief; the call occupies the reversal point between water as threat and water as succor.
changed_reading.before: Water is only the hostile medium from which the people must be removed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the later rain cue activates both gh-y-th relief and its non-dominant gh-w-th distress-cry target. It remains anchored in the focus's explicit wave, call, and rescue, all within a water field. Downstream prose should frame this as a hydrological reversal analogy, not equate rain lexically with the sea wave or assert that the call mechanically causes weather.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Water engulfs, people call, and God rescues; the closing context presents descending water through a relief/cry split inventory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Covering danger strips divided allegiance into unmixed obedience.** **غ ش و B001–B002** is covering veil and overwhelming affliction; **م و ج B001** turbulent intermingling; **ظ ل ل B003/B005** overhead canopy and approaching overshadowing; **خ ل ص B001/B004** purification into unmixed clarity and exclusive separation; **د ي ن B001** obedience. The wave-cover removes ordinary horizons, and invocation becomes exclusive. I infer external enclosure → internal simplification. Crisis does not create the divine object; it strips competing affiliations from the act of submission.
2. **Deliverance is a separation into open truth-bearing land.** **ن ج و B001/B003–B004** is deliverance by separation, extraction, and high separated ground; **ب ر ر B001/B005** is truth that makes action hold and open dry land. The move to shore is materially a separation from intermingling water. I infer that rescue provides a stable field on which the crisis-born claim can either hold true or fail. *Al-barr* therefore activates ethical firmness alongside land.
3. **Moderation can be residual fidelity rather than lukewarmness.** **ق ص د B002–B004** supplies straightness, moderation, and a manageable middle journey. After total crisis-devotion, only “some” remain *muqtaṣid*. I infer that the middle branch may describe a sustainable straight course once emergency intensity falls. This reading coexists with the possibility of reduced commitment; the verse’s partition does not specify which branch exhausts the group.
4. **Knowing denial is a failure of fidelity.** **ج ح د B001** is denial despite knowledge; **ء ي ي B003** visible signs; **خ ت ر B002** treachery as falling short of fidelity; **ك ف ر B004** covering favor. The sea event has made sign and favor experiential, so later denial cannot be simple absence of evidence. I infer recognized rescue → obligation of fidelity. The closing diagnoses denial as betrayal of an acknowledged relation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 31:33 corrected any assumption that rescue can be socially banked: even the closest parent-child relation cannot later substitute. Deliverance creates a personal obligation of fidelity, and the following warning makes its accountability non-transferable.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The carrying medium inverted into an overhead enclosure.** Lexical evidence: `غ ش و B001/B002` is a covering veil and overwhelming affliction, `م و ج B001` is surging turbulence, and `ظ ل ل B003` is an overhead canopy. Structural cue: 31:31's sea carried the ship by blessing; now its wave rises like roof-layers over the passengers. Assigned role: turbulence vertically transforms the medium below into a covering threat above. Abductive move (inferred): the reversal exposes that safe passage depended on an ordered relation the travelers did not control. Reading change: the wave is not only large; it spatially encloses the travelers and strips away their illusion of mastery.

2. **External rescue mirrored by internal purification.** Lexical evidence: `خ ل ص B001/B004` is purification into unmixed clarity and exclusive separation from sharing, `د ي ن B001` is submission, `ن ج و B001` is deliverance by separation, and `ب ر ر B005` is dry land opposed to sea. Structural cue: exclusive devotion occurs under engulfment, then rescue separates the travelers from danger onto land. Assigned role: crisis removes rival devotions inwardly, while rescue removes the travelers from the wave outwardly. Abductive move (inferred): the two separations mirror one another, although only the external one is stated as divine rescue. Reading change: sincerity becomes a crisis-produced clearing of admixture, not simply heightened emotion.

3. **The unstable interval between straight course and treacherous ingratitude.** Lexical evidence: `ق ص د B002/B003` is straightness and moderation, `ج ح د B001` is knowing denial, `خ ت ر B002` is treachery falling short of fidelity, and `ك ف ر B004` is covering a favor. Structural cue: after rescue, only some remain `مُّقْتَصِد`, while the close names denial through treachery and ingratitude; 31:31 had paired patience with gratitude. Assigned role: moderation preserves some continuity between crisis devotion and ordinary life, while treachery and kufr sever that continuity. Abductive move (inferred): post-crisis conduct tests whether temporary purity becomes a stable course. Reading change: `مُّقْتَصِدٌ` marks retained directional integrity amid relapse, not a weak compromise between truth and denial.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - 31:33 named worldly deception as the mechanism by which crisis-purified devotion can decay after rescue. 31:34 then kept vulnerability open beyond the shore: no self knows its next gain or death-ground, so temporary safety cannot justify renewed ingratitude.

words.gloss_range: intensive ingrate linked to the preceding treacherous descriptor
words.prose: {{ar:كَفُورٍۢ}} ({{tr:kafūrin}}) seals the ayah by naming ingrained ingratitude as covering over the rescue just received. Its genitive indefinite form links it to {{ar:خَتَّارٍۢ}} ({{tr:khattārin}}) as the same condemned profile, while its intensive pattern makes the quality settled rather than momentary. The word also reverses the grateful sign-reader of 31:31 and belongs to recurring rescue-to-ingratitude contexts such as 17:67, so the final sound leaves the reader with covered blessing after deliverance.
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, ingratitude, disbelief; local closure selects covering over rescue as settled ingratitude
